title_en: EXCLUSIVE! APARTMENT FOR SALE 2+1 IN FRONT OF STREET 5 - MAJI & NEAR NEW BOULEVARD IN PASKUQAN. €125,000
description_en: TIRANA VIEW RESIDENCE! The newest contemporary project near Route 5 - Maji and the Great Ring in Paskuqan! Tirana View Residence is a modern and contemporary residential project, which will offer the newest architectural trend for a comfortable life with the daily benefits that the area enables after the radical developments that have been made in recent years, such as the Urban Infrastructure, the Great Ring of Tirana and the New Boulevard. The exact location where the Residence is positioned makes it very attractive in terms of its direct connection to Uanaze e Madhe, Rugen 5 Maji and Bulevard e Ri. ► Information on the project: ● The special characteristic of this project is its development mostly oriented to the South, East, West and very little to the North. ● Green spaces and recreational facilities. ● Children's playground and safe environment to play. ● 24-hour guaranteed security inside and around the residence. ● Ventilated facade/thermal insulation for an interior environment unaffected by external noise and atmosphere, enabling energy savings and peace of mind. ● Large windows with glass and hard-aluminum with maximum thermal and insulating parameters. ► Features of the Apartment - 2+1 apartment with an area of ​​109 m2 - Regular floor plan - Balcony For more information contact us.
